notes: Builds for tribes Firestone has no archetype for yet. Each is used only while no Firestone build is for its first tribe ('use': 'when_sources_lack_tribe'), so these retire by themselves once Firestone publishes aberration_* archetypes.
Seeded from docs/research/aberrations-2026-09.md section 8 (36.6.1, day 1). These are hypotheses from card text, 69 Firestone final boards and community posts, not performance-backed comps.
Card IDs are HearthstoneJSON build 251952 base IDs. Cards the live pool no longer has are taken out when the catalog is composed; a build whose core card is gone is left out.
'disabled' lists Firestone archetype IDs to leave out regardless of the pool.

builds.name: Aberration Tea Set
builds.when_to_commit: Gatekeeper Amalgam + Balinda Stonehearth, plus 2 or more cheap Aberrations to reach 3 deaths for the Deity.
builds.tip: Neutral Tea Set with Aberration spell buffs: cast tavern spells on the Amalgam with Balinda, buff spells with Dark Puppeteer or N'raqi Frostcaller. The Amalgam counts as an Aberration for Deity progress; with Y'Shaarj it comes back at full stats if it dies first.

builds.name: Aberration Discard
builds.when_to_commit: A discard activator (Brain Rotter, Abyssal Envoy, Mindbending Recruiter) and a discard payoff (Cutthroat K'Thir, Ghur'sha, Aph'lass).
builds.tip: Discard Sludge Corrosion, Energizing Chamber or Corrupted Coin rather than casting them: discarded, they cast twice. Joyous, Zoatroid and Underrot Spawn carry the early turns and Deity progress; K'Thir, Ghur'sha and Aph'lass scale late.

builds.name: Aberration Tavern Spells
builds.when_to_commit: Vicious Mindslasher or Faceless Converter with a steady source of tavern spells.
builds.tip: Every spell you cast feeds Mindslasher, Sha of Fear and the Deity; Faceless Converter grows with every spell cast this game. Titus Rivendare doubles Converter's Deathrattle.

builds.name: C'Thun Poet Amalgam
builds.when_to_commit: C'Thun lobby, a golden Persistent Poet next to Gatekeeper Amalgam, and 3 Aberrations besides the Amalgam.
builds.tip: When the 3 Aberrations die C'Thun awakens and splits its stats into the Amalgam, and Poet keeps them. Balinda triple-casts spells on the Amalgam; Makeshift Master helps. Single community report: treat as experimental.
